name: Soyuz TMA-21
about: Soyuz TMA-21 (2011-012A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2011 Apr  4. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).
